image_note: Four phases stay in synchronous ULPI: both pull-downs, FS pull-up, LS pull-up, both pull-downs. Each phase samples Debug15 and Status13 sixteen times. The short build uses a 10 ms settling wait and 1 ms sample gaps; the extended build uses 100 ms and 10 ms. Use the capture manifest to identify the build. The final state is detached. No EP0 or device protocol runs in this image; host enumeration is not expected. Raw RxCmd/RxData summaries saturate at 255 and are not packet counts.
note: CSV time labels are retained as exported; they do not establish USB bit timing. CSV contains no GAO ID; select the image layout matching the capture record. Each complete 0,1,2,3 cycle contains eight samples per page and is coherent because the observer commits its 128-bit mailbox only before page 0. There is no snapshot sequence or freshness flag: a capture need not contain a newly acknowledged snapshot, and repeated page cycles may show the same previous snapshot. Before any 60 MHz acknowledgement, payload pages are zero. The clock count is a separate 10 ms measurement; zero persists after a full stopped-clock window. This is not a complete ULPI or USB protocol trace.
